notes.title: Update(Demo) 0.2.0 - New cards, new arena, new game mode and more!
notes.content:
[h1]The world of [b]GELETERRA[/b] is full of news![/h1]

[h2]New legendary spells[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Passion Meteor:[/b] For 10 mana, deals 10 damage to target tile plus 5 to adjacent tiles.
[*] [b]Blizzard:[/b] For 0 mana, freezes all enemy slimes.
[/list]
We felt one legendary spell wasn't enough for all decks, so now "Black Hole" has two powerful competitors!

[h2]New common spells[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bath:[/b] For 4 mana, removes all effects from target slime.
[*] [b]Acid Rain:[/b] For 4 mana, poisons all enemy slimes.
[*] [b]Tremor:[/b] For 4 mana, removes construction from target tile.
[*] [b]Kiss:[/b] For 2 mana, applies "Passion" to target slime.
[*] [b]Protection:[/b] For 2 mana, applies "Protection" to target slime.
[/list]

[h2]New addition: Effects[/h2]
Effects are modifiers that change slimes' behavior. Some were already in-game but weren't officially "Effects".

[list]
[*] [b]Freeze:[/b] Frozen slimes can't attack next turn (removes after).
[*] [b]Passion:[/b] When attacking, 2/6 chance to self-damage (removes on trigger).
[*] [b]Confusion:[/b] When attacking, 2/6 chance to miss (removes on trigger).
[*] [b]Poison:[/b] Deals 1 damage at start of placement phase.
[*] [b]Explosion:[/b] Attacks deal half damage (rounded down) to adjacent tiles.
[*] [b]Protection:[/b] Blocks next attack's damage completely.
[/list]

[h2]New slimes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Necromancer:[/b]
  [list]
  [*] HP: 4
  [*] Damage: 1
  [*] Active: For 1 mana, summons Ghost on target tile.
  [/list]
[*] [b]Ghost:[/b]
  [list]
  [*] HP: 2
  [*] Damage: 1
  [*] Passive: Always attacks enemy hero during its turn.
  [/list]
[/list]

[h2]New buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Steel Forge:[/b] For 3 mana, gives +1 armor to slime on tile.
[*] [b]Gunpowder Canyon:[/b] For 5 mana, grants "Explosion" to slime on tile.
[/list]

[h2]New game mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Player vs AI:[/b] Battle against computer opponents in this new mode.
[/list]
This 100% single-player experience lets you enjoy Gelecard solo. We'll keep improving the AI in future updates.

[h2]Removed cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Sprout:[/b] While charming, we felt Necromancer better fit "Dark Forest" identity (still appears as Brotinho's evolution).
[*] [b]Big Factory & Refinery:[/b] Removed due to similar effects among Miner buildings.
[/list]

[h2]Card changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cheese Bread:[/b] Nerfed to balance Miner deck:
  [list]
  [*] HP: 3→2
  [*] Damage: 2→1
  [/list]
[*] [b]Little Miner:[/b] Adjusted for balance:
  [list]
  [*] HP: 5→4
  [*] Damage: 4→3
  [/list]
[*] [b]Ore:[/b] New active ability:
  [list]
  [*] For 6 mana, deals 1 damage to all enemy slimes
  [/list]
[*] [b]Little Sprout:[/b] Faster evolution but weaker:
  [list]
  [*] HP: 2→1
  [*] Now evolves after 1 turn (was 2)
  [/list]
[*] [b]Sprout:[/b] Adjusted for balance:
  [list]
  [*] HP: 4→3
  [/list]
[*] [b]Graveyard:[/b] New thematic effect:
  [list]
  [*] When allied slime dies here, summons Ghost
  [/list]
[*] [b]Lake of Regret:[/b] More distinct identity:
  [list]
  [*] Enemy slimes attacking here get -1 damage
  [/list]
[*] [b]Cardinal:[/b] New support ability:
  [list]
  [*] For 2 mana, heals adjacent allies +2
  [/list]
[*] [b]Believer:[/b] Healing cost increased:
  [list]
  [*] Active cost: 1→2
  [/list]
[*] [b]Cathedral:[/b] Effect moved to Basilica
[*] [b]Basilica:[/b] Now grants:
  [list]
  [*] +3 max HP to all allies when slime present
  [/list]
[*] [b]Marshmallow:[/b] Complete rework:
  [list]
  [*] New active: Resurrect last dead slime (costs its mana)
  [*] HP: 5→12
  [*] Damage: 5→0
  [/list]
[/list]

[h2]New arena[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Barbarian Camp:[/b] New battle arena showcasing barbarians' homeland.
[/list]

[h2]Visual changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New button animations[/b]
[*] [b]Animated text effects[/b] for cards
[*] [b]Board redesign[/b] with pastel colors
[*] [b]Armor display[/b] in UI
[*] [b]Double Attack stacks[/b] now visible
[*] [b]Effects[/b] now show below health bar
[/list]

[h2]Summary[/h2]
This update brings more life and variety to matches, plus new ways to play. Thanks to everyone trying the demo! We're working hard to make [b]Gelecard[/b] the best it can be!

[b]How to play demo?[/b]
Available for free in Steam - just visit the store page and download!

notes.title: Update(Demo) 0.1.12
notes.content:
[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Rapadura:[/b] Rapadura no longer reflects magic damage.
[*] [b]Pudding:[/b] "Pudding Jr." is no longer always spawned awake. Now, it depends on the current status of the Pudding.
[*] [b]Ice:[/b] Frozen slimes can no longer use active abilities.
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New poison effect:[/b] New effect to indicate when a slime is poisoned.
[*] [b]Localization:[/b] New translations added for almost all texts currently included in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Slime spawn circle:[/b] The effect appeared incorrectly at certain times.
[*] [b]Consumable actives:[/b] Consumable actives can no longer be used on the user themselves.
[*] [b]Slimes not spawning when taking damage:[/b] The slime spawn animation is no longer interrupted when receiving damage.
[*] [b]Mana cost for actives:[/b] The cost of the active ability is now only deducted from the player when the action is actually performed.
[*] [b]Candy spawn audio:[/b] Removed sound that played incorrectly during the spawning of candy slimes.
[*]  [b]Using actives on the wrong turn:[/b] It is no longer possible to use active abilities of opponent slimes or during any turn other than your placement turn.
[*] [b]Slimepedia:[/b] Fixed a bug that occurred when switching sections of the Slimepedia multiple times.
[*] [b]Arena selection interface:[/b] Even though arenas are not yet available for selection, the interface is now set up.
[*] [b]Bishop:[/b] The Bishop's passive no longer stops working after playing multiple matches with the game running.
[/list]

[h2]Summary[/h2]

Small update aimed at resolving some more urgent issues that were compromising the quality of gameplay. We are working hard to make the game experience even better.

Stay tuned, as we will soon bring more news to the battlefields of Gelecard!

[h2]How to play the demo?[/h2]

If you're interested in taking a peek at what we're planning for Gelecard, you can test the online and local player vs player mode while we're still finishing things up.

To do this, simply go to the game's page and look for the free download option. After that, just head to your library, call your friends, and have fun!
